title: Used .{1} on something that is nil
why: The value before .{1} does not exist: it was never found, the name is misspelled, or it was destroyed.
fix: Check the name you looked up with find(), or guard it: if thing then ... end

pattern: attempt to call a nil value \(method '([^']+)'\)
title: {1} is not a method of this value
why: Nothing called {1} exists on the value you called it on.
fix: Check the spelling and the class in the reference. Methods are called with a colon: thing:{1}()

pattern: attempt to call a nil value \(field '([^']+)'\)
title: {1} is not a function
why: The field {1} is nil, so it can not be called.
fix: Check the spelling. A method needs a colon, thing:{1}(), not a dot.

pattern: attempt to call a nil value \(global '([^']+)'\)
title: {1} does not exist
why: There is no global called {1} on this side of the game.
fix: Check the spelling. camera and input only exist in client scripts, game.players.joined only on the server.

title: Maths on a {1}
why: One side of + - * / is a {1}, not a number.
fix: Make sure both values are numbers, tonumber() turns text into a number.

title: Joined text with a {1}
fix: Wrap it in tostring(value) before joining.

title: Compared a {1} with a {2}
why: Only numbers with numbers, or text with text, can be ordered.
fix: Convert one side with tonumber() or tostring().

title: A client script changed {1}.{2}
why: The server owns the world{3}. A client may only change interface instances, what it made itself, and what its player owns.
fix: Send a Remote to the server and change it there, or setOwner the part to the player on the server.

title: The remote {1} refused a message
why: It accepts ({2}) but was sent {3} argument(s).
fix: Set its accepts property to the kinds it carries, like "string" or "string, number?".

title: The remote {1} got the wrong kind of value
why: Argument {2} should be a {3} but a {4} was sent.
fix: Change what fireServer sends, or the accepts list on the remote.

title: Argument {1} has the wrong type
fix: Look at the call on that line and the signature in the reference.

title: {1} has no {2}
fix: Check the spelling and the reference for {1}. Properties are camelCase, like walkSpeed.

title: Not an allowed value for {1}
fix: Use one of those, written exactly.

title: Missing file {1}
why: Nothing exists at that path in the place.
fix: Check the path and extension. The Assets panel can copy a file's path.

title: The {2} can not load {1}
why: A client only loads client/ and shared/, the server only server/ and shared/.
fix: Move what both sides need into shared/.

title: Two modules require each other
fix: Move what they share into a third module that both require.

title: The script does not parse
why: Luau could not read the code near that line.
fix: Look for a missing end, closing bracket or quote just before the line it names.

pattern: that instance is not part of the scene
title: That is not part of the scene
why: It was made by the engine or a script, so the editor can not save it.
fix: Edit instances that come from the scene file, or turn the script's work into scene instances.

title: The engine controls that property
why: It is rewritten every tick, so an edit would be lost.
fix: Change what drives it instead, like the joint rather than the limb.
